```{r}
file_path = "/srv/shiny-server/snip/processed_data/"
load(here(file_path, "weekly_screening.RData"))
load(here(file_path, "exit_df.RData"))
load(here(file_path, "entry_df.RData"))


```

```{r}
weekly_screening_plot <- weekly_screening %>%
  group_by(Site = redcap_data_access_group) %>%
  summarise(
    `Total screened` = sum(t_screen_scr, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Total eligible` = sum(t_eligible_scr, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Total enrolled` = sum(t_eligible_enrol_scr, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(Site = factor(Site, levels = Site[order(-`Total screened`)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = `Total screened`:`Total enrolled`, names_to = "Status", values_to = "Count") %>%
  mutate(Status = factor(Status, levels = c("Total screened", "Total eligible", "Total enrolled")))

ggplot(weekly_screening_plot, aes(Site, Count, fill = Status)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count), position = position_dodge(0.9), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Screening Summary", x = "Site", y = "Count", fill = "Status") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
weekly_screening_summary <- weekly_screening %>%
  group_by(
    Site = redcap_data_access_group,
    Week = week,
    Week_Start_Date = s_date_scr,
    Week_End_Date   = e_date_scr
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Screened = sum(t_screen_scr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Eligible_n = sum(t_eligible_scr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Not_Eligible_n = sum(t_not_eligible_scr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Enrolled_n = sum(t_eligible_enrol_scr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Not_Enrolled_n = sum(t_eligible_not_enrol_scr, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Eligible = paste0(Eligible_n, " (", round(Eligible_n / Screened * 100, 1), "%)"),
    Not_Eligible = paste0(Not_Eligible_n, " (", round(Not_Eligible_n / Screened * 100, 1), "%)"),
    Enrolled = paste0(Enrolled_n, " (", round(Enrolled_n / Eligible_n * 100, 1), "%)"),
    Not_Enrolled = paste0(Not_Enrolled_n, " (", round(Not_Enrolled_n / Eligible_n * 100, 1), "%)")
  ) %>%
  select(Site, Week, Week_Start_Date, Week_End_Date, 
         Screened, Eligible, Not_Eligible, Enrolled, Not_Enrolled)


kbl(weekly_screening_summary, valign = "t", booktabs = T,linesep = "\\addlinespace") %>% 
kable_styling(latex_options = "scale_down",full_width = T,font_size = 10)
```
#### Reasons for Not Eligible
```{r}
reasons_not_elig_df <- weekly_screening %>% 
  select(site_scr,age_greater_29days_scr, sepsis_criteria_not_met_scr,other_not_eligible_scr, other1_not_elig_spec_scr,other2_not_elig_spec_scr)

reasons_not_eligible_summary <- reasons_not_elig_df %>% 
  select(
    Site = site_scr,
    `Age>29 days` = age_greater_29days_scr,
    `Did not meet sepsis criteria` = sepsis_criteria_not_met_scr,
    `Other` = other_not_eligible_scr
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Site,
    names_to = "Reason",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Reason, Site) %>%
  summarise(Count = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Site,
    values_from = Count,
    values_fill = 0
  )
 
kbl(reasons_not_eligible_summary, valign = "t", booktabs = T,linesep = "\\addlinespace") %>%
kable_styling(latex_options = "striped",full_width = T,font_size = 14)
```
#### Enrolment
```{r}

admitted_kpi <- as.numeric(length(which(!is.na(entry_df$date_adm))))
enrolled_kpi <- as.numeric(length(which(!is.na(entry_df$date_enrol_adm))))
currently_in_ward_kpi <- as.numeric(
  entry_df %>%
    filter(!record_id %in% exit_df$record_id) %>%  # not yet exited
    distinct(record_id) %>%
    nrow()
)
currently_in_ward_kpi = paste0(currently_in_ward_kpi, " (", round(currently_in_ward_kpi/admitted_kpi*100,1), "%)")
discharged_alive_kpi <- as.numeric(length(which(exit_df$outcome_sc == "Alive")))
discharged_alive_kpi = paste0(discharged_alive_kpi, " (", round(discharged_alive_kpi/enrolled_kpi*100,1), "%)")
deaths_kpi <- as.numeric(length(which(exit_df$outcome_sc == "Died")))
deaths_kpi = paste0(deaths_kpi, " (", round(deaths_kpi/enrolled_kpi*100,1), "%)")
lama_kpi <- as.numeric(length(which(exit_df$outcome_sc == "Left against medical advice")))
transferred_kpi <- as.numeric(length(which(exit_df$outcome_sc == "Transferred")))
absconded_kpi <- as.numeric(length(which(exit_df$outcome_sc == "Absconded")))

kpi_value_boxes <- data.frame(admitted_kpi = admitted_kpi,enrolled_kpi = enrolled_kpi, currently_in_ward_kpi = currently_in_ward_kpi,discharged_alive_kpi = discharged_alive_kpi,deaths_kpi = deaths_kpi, lama_kpi = lama_kpi,transferred_kpi =transferred_kpi,absconded_kpi  )
kpi_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  KPI = c(
    "Admitted",
    "Enrolled",
    "Currently in Ward",
    "Discharged Alive",
    "Deaths",
    "Left Against Medical Advice",
    "Transferred",
    "Absconded"
  ),
  Value = c(
    admitted_kpi,
    enrolled_kpi,
    currently_in_ward_kpi,
    discharged_alive_kpi,
    deaths_kpi,
    lama_kpi,
    transferred_kpi,
    absconded_kpi
  )
)
kbl(kpi_summary, valign = "t", booktabs = T,linesep = "\\addlinespace") %>%
kable_styling(latex_options = "striped",full_width = T,font_size = 14)
```
